Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 3, "heading": "I\nLA GRAND'SALLE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u003-b0082", "target": "Затем настал черёд других сановников.", "source_sha256": "16d8b0f22eccd3593dee157acf7f6c20a51bd1fbb562103e54f54a768769b442", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u003-b0082", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5cb8be5ca9a6da881e274996fe0efb08b79b7ade01b2669fbe6ed07940d579ae"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u003-b0083", "target": "«Долой беделей! Долой булавоносцев!", "source_sha256": "65edc860337377496efc53bb8cba2b90ca87ca2c42a644db83dddec2d916bc8a", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u003-b0083", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "8ffe1b98c7c2a3940eb69f37ba2eed4575d4ebe605d3e37e86942f0a65579cc4"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 1, "chapter": 1, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u003-b0084", "text": "—Dis donc, Robin Poussepain, qu'est-ce que c'est donc que celui-là?", "sha256": "087ba7789e023de1ab7d8ff695a139695d875e2ea97dd3c3093cb9b8dddd8538", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [119], "source_xml_sha256": "3570ab258a4201efe558ee8357bca15692e4cf38731f5c3bccb0f252f4473541", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0085", "text": "—C'est Gilbert de Suilly, [[I]]Gilbertus de Soliaco[[/I]], le chancelier du collège d'Autun.", "sha256": "d14deaf261964fa69dff39121da059efae172724761792924559f9466181a1b0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [120], "source_xml_sha256": "c2881cc15de83fd2fb25bc4a93026405cacd4cb0b1bfd1b9fa7b6afb38dd9dfe", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0086", "text": "—Tiens, voici mon soulier: tu es mieux placé que moi; jette-le-lui par la figure.", "sha256": "e54c235c409d6b87150f992c26695f8723011a63849b212ebf104cedb8347412", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [121], "source_xml_sha256": "89a3c342b867708e6d20a98f5c34d7301e4405c41f8e9be4de77ab69c1b7723e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0087", "text": "—[[I]]Saturnalitias mittimus ecce nuces[[/I]][[N6]].", "sha256": "76066eb0119782a506a44093842680bfb7510f76855f01cb4af637649f150687", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [122], "source_xml_sha256": "9c7774790d54b137a39af07d74a813304e5ec6bd985cc167b4566a4bcaa1ef59", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N6]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0088", "text": "—À bas les six théologiens avec leurs surplis blancs!", "sha256": "f9dad4d39e12e26e00fca2dfd2fba91c2ceb92ccf6a9d28b41a5547075abb195", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [123], "source_xml_sha256": "0cf16d8407efbd4639dc6d61a97227911742754161b4b3b5e7427366f9ed90ab", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0089", "text": "—Ce sont là les théologiens? Je croyais que c'étaient les six oies blanches données par Sainte-Geneviève à la ville, pour le fief de Roogny.", "sha256": "7fc045bad419a8df21890f3929197fbf73ff5ecaf6a29fc71d64fd152430296f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [124], "source_xml_sha256": "bda6a409ad394dbb0b68c68e7e1d4df5694818a79b676450de1befd573cb69b9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0090", "text": "—À bas les médecins!", "sha256": "c64bbf951e6371ec22299976f7c9e383b3fe8aa3782943096a73909d009773e4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [125], "source_xml_sha256": "03beea10a59f026aafc489f1342aef961315e308aa252f4106a1de7d26da5f64", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0091", "text": "—À bas les disputations cardinales et quodlibétaires!", "sha256": "76c10e6479e7fdec52dfeaf77be31ad87caf754ebbb267ecde6cb45b7f0cfe93", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [126], "source_xml_sha256": "f0acf1d72c791d70d950487c7d14a8cbe8b03189ebb7a3bb0c45f9f34c1d673a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0092", "text": "—À toi ma coiffe, chancelier de Sainte-Geneviève! tu m'as fait un passe-droit.—C'est vrai cela! il a donné ma place dans la nation de Normandie au petit Ascanio Falzaspada, qui est de la province de Bourges, puisqu'il est Italien.", "sha256": "5865437145fc5aebb6ac9856f222fc48900a8497f8dd0d2cc1a6c8441d84f997", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [127], "source_xml_sha256": "950e9eea6da1137ef6be5f14eaf2ac00f18ddfde302150d84dbbfbc074deef39", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0093", "text": "—C'est une injustice, dirent tous les écoliers. À bas le chancelier de Sainte-Geneviève!", "sha256": "b38825b6366ad522bc6f8ced6e1908b1c53d72c23e37f73095057a6b8b0fbc05", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [128], "source_xml_sha256": "0a5e4a83d9d574c70b45aed4ff4c92e680365d596854787d2654521f10013309", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0094", "text": "—Ho hé! maître Joachim de Ladehors! Ho hé! Louis Dahuille! Ho hé! Lambert Hoctement!", "sha256": "4a182a51bd246b6e07183a6a11b9388a173a3584622d4e5ce8559aa440375be6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [129], "source_xml_sha256": "c1fcbcce47bf6ac3de9d5f938323ea6bfcccd878f126d2ca67d32ff72f21215e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0095", "text": "—Que le diable étouffe le procureur de la nation d'Allemagne!", "sha256": "e2f3f312136eb2cf94b616d7c0f4052bc06420947c3e2d54973118ffaa5df31e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [130], "source_xml_sha256": "c0c07a3a140c957bda8ed1f32e034e12005170256ac2adeb381ba1416b21465a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0096", "text": "—Et les chapelains de la Sainte-Chapelle, avec leurs aumusses grises; [[I]]cum tunicis grisis[[/I]]!", "sha256": "c2ddbc91e3bce6cc0de1e6846e9376f9cfe2abb6eda2fe2df02e41bca86b91c1", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [131], "source_xml_sha256": "422bbe645597d7003b4cc7d56c8096efa3ce0a0aa7bd7f74827341c0e01775a7", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0097", "text": "—[[I]]Seu de pellibus grisis fourratis[[/I]][[N7]]!", "sha256": "c260e974082318ab4bed566c6dcc7d387ed03ec1da23ad615acbf08ce967598f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [132], "source_xml_sha256": "ca500a7f9141afc9df817b66b22c68c7766822daa377fd5a5030faba138d2b2c", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N7]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0098", "text": "—Holàhée! les maîtres ès arts! Toutes les belles chapes noires! toutes les belles chapes rouges!", "sha256": "56cba45aa4dcecf44a4cb351461266f2a42b529d41b8d3d247665f7d44730f97", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [133], "source_xml_sha256": "0ca0ad770a39d9de2cf66ae394da9ae949f34b718490cc7d84eb406a7a4cbb2b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0099", "text": "—Cela fait une belle queue au recteur.", "sha256": "2302cecc2188973b6586fe8b74a20817b7433f2f8dfb168250a98adef5d379ad", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [134], "source_xml_sha256": "226633a48fd1feac384df35850b4bc8d62e0cc7e21065ea6dc2c8df9c06b812f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0100", "text": "—On dirait un duc de Venise qui va aux épousailles de la mer.", "sha256": "1512debf1e506989d5b9ee4b0446ac67a899c2c616a4f55bc068f4a8aae8b1a5", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [135], "source_xml_sha256": "d6c083021c159b13e29cf50f244092ad3c850986b544530020229ed8fedd5e5e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0101", "text": "—Dis donc, Jehan! les chanoines de Sainte-Geneviève!", "sha256": "25171af055abd537e05448355bc3e76b60aeee57dc9c144ee0c448701fdff465", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [136], "source_xml_sha256": "33c906e0768114ce7c629aac27d56c341a3820a395ea7cf9d934076ac0ba1b60", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0102", "text": "—Au diable la chanoinerie!", "sha256": "37823bd2b98394d427e2780c3f1abecadba53578b6bf726152e382f47fd551be", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [137], "source_xml_sha256": "25f87a9a89da605507cf46fe7d0396c478502a11d66fea1a1731183e77948c48", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0103", "text": "—Abbé Claude Choart! docteur Claude Choart! Est-ce que vous cherchez Marie la Giffarde?", "sha256": "b5a95a663fb70ce2e4d7f1c66cf01e604c5b6c53aae9c64bc621afaff1a557b6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [138], "source_xml_sha256": "162d882a94e40fada991355e5eb8dc20bea4706e6f1c5947bd13ea82cec47266", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0104", "text": "—Elle est rue de Glatigny.", "sha256": "0755063db3e7237afe687b259dcf982539451bf0df423d10662e69f9c7455579", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [139], "source_xml_sha256": "8568f00e9e6b0cd188747f4d9f9436cceded19d8ed6af2fd117f8297766e53f7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0105", "text": "—Elle fait le lit du roi des ribauds.", "sha256": "1ac9335c21c1e723483c9c2dddd470fc01d3727f448d02510483e216797817a1", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [140], "source_xml_sha256": "809b7adf5089ddd434b909cac9a0f98885ba96d625abd8ea8f3826a4a7c6f091", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0106", "text": "—Elle paie ses quatre deniers; [[I]]quatuor denarios[[/I]].", "sha256": "7ec2de852762803c122bb2233205a6dede904c512619d10bfdc69d4c3306baac", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [141], "source_xml_sha256": "2cd8569724e1dc26c71fd57f0bc9e737858a3690e1310a8f3bc16804f270317a", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0107", "text": "—[[I]]Aut unum bombum[[/I]][[N8]].", "sha256": "0afe4de3fa2a92ee3a8afa9e7501b5e4ec2e4e11e14c38e18876946d8bf15b2a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [142], "source_xml_sha256": "36a227e5929ba2cd5cc457b4eb69d5d9ba53c3f6ca9e2fb607c0736d64f30c05", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N8]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0108", "text": "—Voulez-vous qu'elle vous paie au nez?", "sha256": "148295ccccf6b23e310cba42f34798a53b8a99815684ef85b7987e7e6fd1bb96", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [143], "source_xml_sha256": "2054ee019e6d389e4622011aef31d182370cde4d7a193ff3ad35a0e701c66228", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0109", "text": "—Camarades! maître Simon Sanguin, l'électeur de Picardie, qui a sa femme en croupe.", "sha256": "d3db2b7e6a716cf3c5f4730e08de3af17fbb2de1d905066b712fb9c63dc7c577", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [144], "source_xml_sha256": "8be92bdf869fbc2049232e0da45c26c5e34c92292b459815db8f1e91bf7324d4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0110", "text": "—[[I]]Post equitem sedet atra cura[[/I]][[N9]].", "sha256": "463a14daa3a7a218b7a21989745b46612e1089d3c3b7df87eef47c9925fb874b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [145], "source_xml_sha256": "26bf9ff544586f6e7f004040f17b800fd9ed7e86cd593378fa96260a3d3e6de2", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N9]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0111", "text": "—Hardi, maître Simon!", "sha256": "4ef55f47acae58f2adad6a38a20275d14f6e7a5bb3a84279a693e7089ed52e8c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [146], "source_xml_sha256": "f0f53e8d95c6d930eedde446583e8e957fbfcf3f2446299a94cd8ed792e035a2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0112", "text": "—Bonjour, monsieur l'électeur!", "sha256": "8ca665e025291755ff3bcf5851855f0cfb7ae869ae415a1507de024ebeca8958", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [147], "source_xml_sha256": "0a339ceb98e84626a2a068ebbe1cbb8b32e1c93e12bd4c100eefce4c29e8dc3b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0113", "text": "—Bonne nuit, madame l'électrice!", "sha256": "960f5cba7b27e87df99982f600036efd5b6faf0147652480ede4ec10e2512192", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [148], "source_xml_sha256": "8e37ec7fb559c850acf49525420a40fe068ea3edefc491c602db9800dbd893e7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0114", "text": "—Sont-ils heureux de voir tout cela», disait en soupirant [[I]]Joannes de Molendino[[/I]], toujours perché dans les feuillages de son chapiteau.", "sha256": "869178e543c61e9c2e0ddbdaff14caf070efbb79dadadc58a6a16aaf6f90bd1a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [149], "source_xml_sha256": "b6cd3c49187b6cfd061f8bf1ed281dba902d23c9d31068d8fab5e3c8c84541d5", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0115", "text": "Cependant le libraire juré de l'Université, maître Andry Musnier, se penchait à l'oreille du pelletier-fourreur des robes du roi, maître Gilles Lecornu.", "sha256": "19c81eea9cfbc2c3ddf95cd83c446f804cd54f614dab9fa9301548a8d56eca96", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [150], "source_xml_sha256":
